about: A SKILL.md per case and the tool lists a reader must take from it: `declared` is its allowed-tools read verbatim, `headless` what a non-interactive run is granted, and `mcp` / `programmatic`, where a case has them, its mcp-tools and programmatic-tools. A case with `refused` is a skill whose allowed-tools field is there but lists no tool, or is written only in a form neither reader can read; both readers refuse it. A case with `headless_refused` declares tools but none a non-interactive run can use; both readers refuse it headless (#2390). internal/skillrender (splitFrontmatter, splitTools, FilterHeadlessTools) and the SDK (skillAllowedTools.ts) both read this file (#2358, #2385).
